title: Electrochemistry Boot Camp CV Data
description:
• Data were collected on 09/20/2012
  • The electrochemical cell consisted of:
    • Pt/Ir working electrode
    • Ag/AgCl reference electrode
    • Pt wire counter electrode
  • Scan rates of 20mV/s, 50 mV/s, 100mV/s, 150 mV/s, and 200mV/s were tested
  • A 10 sec quiet time was used for all scans (stir bar off after mixing for 30 sec)
  • The solution was composed of:
    • potassium ferrocyanide (4 mM) as redox probe

title: Dataset of the research article "Guanidium Unmasked: Repurposing Common Amide Coupling Reagents for the Synthesis of Pentasubstituted Guanidine Bases"
description: The dataset contains primary data related to the article entitled "Guanidium Unmasked: Repurposing Common Amide Coupling Reagents for the Synthesis of Pentasubstituted Guanidine Bases", published in the Journal of Organic Chemistry, 2025. The dataset contains NMR data for the characterization of compounds, reaction kinetics and competition experiments.

title: DataSet for the article: Modeling the Reactivity of Diffusion-Limited Enzyme in Single-Entity Electrochemistry
description: Dataset accompanying the article 'Modeling the Reactivity of Diffusion-Limited Enzyme in Single-Entity Electrochemistry' contains comprehensive electrochemical and particle analysis data, including cyclic voltammetry (CV) curves, single-entity electrochemistry (SEE) signals, analyzed curves, and Dynamic Light Scattering (DLS) size distributions. All files are systematically named to correspond directly with their respective figure numbers in the manuscript.

title: AN INTERACTIVE CHEMISTRY GAME FOR EDUCATIONAL ENGAGEMENT
description: This project aimed to develop an interactive chemistry game accessible on mobile devices and computers to make learning basic chemistry concepts more engaging for students. The game was created using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, ensuring cross-platform compatibility. Initial tests showed that the game successfully captured students' interest with its intuitive interface and appealing design.
